sentences.text:
Applicant :- Munna Lal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Shahabuddin
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Pathak,J.
1.

The present applicant has invoked the inherent jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. assailing the summoning order dated 16.03.2023 and bailable warrant dated 01.04.2023 passed by the Judicial Magistrate in Case No. 1830 of 2019.

2. Perusal of record reveals that on complaint moved on behalf of opposite party no. 2, process has been issued by the Civil Judge (Junior Division)FTC, Pilibhit in Case No. 148, under Section 376/511 I.P.C., vide order dated 28.06.2018.

Having been aggrieved against the said order, present applicant (accused) has approached to this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C., being Application No. 28273 of 2018 (Munna Lal vs. State of U.P. and others).

entities.text: Munna Lal vs. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court, vide order dated 28.08.2018, has granted interim relief staying the further proceeding in the complaint case in pursuance of the summoning order dated 28.06.2018.

During pendency of the instant application, learned trial court has passed Munna Lal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91440956/
1 the fresh summoning order dated 16.03.2023 and issued bailable warrant dated 01.04.2023 in light of the dictum of Hon?ble Supreme Court in the matter of Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Private Limited and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation (2018) 16 SCC 299.

entities.text: Munna Lal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Private Limited and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation (2018) 16 SCC 299
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Consequently, the applicant has taken second attempt by way of moving instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
assailing the summoning order and bailable warrant issued against him.

3. In this conspectus, as above, I am of the considered opinion that instant second application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. moved on behalf of the present applicant is not maintainable in light of the fact that entire criminal proceeding is already assailed before this Court in connected Criminal Misc.
Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No. 28273 of 2018.

As such, instant application is dismissed,
being misconceived and devoid of merits.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Pkb/
